default.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 30 days. MDAC must be submitted online within 3 days before arrival.

groups.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 90 days. MDAC must be submitted online within 3 days before arrival.
Visa-free entry for up to 30 days under ASEAN arrangements. MDAC required within 3 days before arrival.
An eVisa is required — apply only at the official portal malaysiavisa.imi.gov.my. MDAC must also be submitted within 3 days before arrival.

MY.notes: Malaysian citizens enter freely with a valid Malaysian passport.

CN.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 30 days under the exemption for Chinese citizens, extended through 31 December 2026. MDAC required within 3 days before arrival.

IN.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 30 days under the exemption for Indian citizens, extended through 31 December 2026. MDAC required within 3 days before arrival.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders may not enter Malaysia without prior approval from the Ministry of Home Affairs; Malaysia does not maintain diplomatic relations with Israel.

KP.notes: A visa is required; Malaysia suspended diplomatic relations with North Korea in 2021, so apply through a Malaysian mission abroad and confirm current arrangements.
